meta.name: gpt-image-2
meta.description: Generate and edit images using OpenAI's GPT Image 2 API. Interactive skill that guides users through image creation with style presets, cost-aware draft/final workflow, thinking mode, carousels, and photo editing. This skill should be used when the user requests image generation via OpenAI/GPT Image 2, wants to create social media carousels, edit photos into artistic styles, or needs images with readable text (infographics, diagrams, posters).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenAI 模型生成和编辑图片，支持多种风格和轮播图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成高质量图片或编辑照片为艺术风格
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images using OpenAI's GPT Image 2 API with style presets and carousels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate high-quality images or edit photos into artistic styles

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会引导你通过交互流程生成和编辑图片：先选类型（单图、轮播图、修图等），再选风格、尺寸，自动先出草稿，确认后再生成高质量版，并报告花费。
howto.when: 当你要求用 OpenAI/GPT Image 2 生成图片，或要做社交媒体轮播图、把照片变成艺术风格、或需要包含可读文字的图片（如信息图、海报）时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张科幻风格的火箭宣传图，用编辑模式。
say.note: 启动单图生成流程，先出草稿。

say.text: 设计一个10页的LinkedIn轮播图，主题是远程办公优势。
say.note: 启动轮播图工作流，Claude会先帮你规划每页内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through an interactive workflow to generate and edit images: choose type (single, carousel, photo edit, etc.), pick style and size, automatically generate a draft first, then final with high quality upon approval, and report costs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request image generation via OpenAI/GPT Image 2, want to create social media carousels, edit photos into artistic styles, or need images with readable text (infographics, diagrams, posters).

say_en.text: Generate a sci-fi rocket promotional image in editorial style.
say_en.note: Starts the single image interactive flow with draft first.

say_en.text: Create a 10-slide LinkedIn carousel about remote work benefits.
say_en.note: Initiates the carousel workflow; Claude will propose a slide plan.
